carrot.linePrev: Some say that they're coming back in a garden
carrot.line: Bunch of carrots and little sweet peas
carrot.lineNext: I think I'll just let the mystery be
stanza: Some say once gone you're gone forever
And some say you're going to come back
Some say you rest in the arms of the Saviour
If in sinful ways you lack
Some say that they're coming back in a garden
Bunch of carrots and little sweet peas
I think I'll just let the mystery be

carrot.songTitle: The King of Carrot Flowers, Pt. One
carrot.line: When you were young, you were the king of carrot flowers
carrot.lineNext: And how you built a tower tumbling through the trees
stanza: When you were young, you were the king of carrot flowers
And how you built a tower tumbling through the trees
In holy rattlesnakes that fell all around your feet
And your mom would stick a fork right into daddy's shoulder
And dad would throw the garbage all across the floor
As we would lay and learn what each other's bodies were for
